description: Scaffold a new service (service.json, Dockerfile, source and a test) with `flisk resource <name> --json`, or register an existing directory that already has a service.json. Returns the structured envelope: data.action is `created` or `registered`, with data.name, data.path, data.port, data.type, data.stack, data.framework, data.language and data.discovered; a failure is errors with a code and suggestions. Without stack it uses the only existing stack or `main`, and fails when several stacks exist. Do not call it again for a resource that already exists: that rewrites its service.json and can assign it a new port (check with resource_list first). Call `up` afterwards to start it. Set projectPath when the MCP server is not running from the project root. CLI equivalent: `flisk resource <name> --json`.

durability.description: Where agent sessions are checkpointed (type agent only): files or postgres

features.description: Resource features to enable, for example prisma or drizzle

framework.description: Frontend: react (default), vue, svelte, preact, lit, solid, qwik, vanilla, tanstack-router, next. Backend: hono (default), express, elysia, fastify, nestjs, koa, h3. Database: postgres (default, the shared Flisk Postgres), redis, qdrant, mlflow, mysql, mongodb, clickhouse (each its own container; the services that list it in dependsOn get its connection settings). Queue: nats (default), rabbitmq. Storage: minio (default). Mail: mailpit (default, local SMTP and inbox). Payment: stripe-mock (default, Stripe API emulator)

language.description: Backend language: bun (default), python, go, rust, node

local.description: Frontend, backend, worker, mcp or agent: scaffold it to run on this computer with no Docker or Tilt (a command in service.json; a plain Vite config for a frontend), the way flisk create does by default

name.description: Resource name (kebab-case: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, for example my-service)

port.description: Port within the type's range (default: the next free one)

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the Flisk project root; run this operation from that directory.

stack.description: Stack to assign the resource to

type.description: Resource type (default backend). Redis, Qdrant, MinIO, MLflow, MySQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse, NATS, RabbitMQ, Mailpit and stripe-mock are frameworks: type database, queue, storage, mail or payment plus framework

name: resource_create
